title: Cheese Tortellini in Homemade Alfredo
description: One bag frozen cheese tortellini (about 19 to 25 oz) in a homemade alfredo. Serves 2 for dinner + 2 for lunch.

ingredients.item: salt, black pepper, pinch of garlic powder

steps: Big pot of salted water to a boil. Cook tortellini per the bag (usually 3 to 5 min, they float when done). Save 1/2 cup pasta water, then drain.
While the water heats: in a large skillet or pot over medium-low, melt the butter. Add garlic, stir 1 min. Don't let it brown.
Add the cream. Bring to a gentle simmer (small bubbles, not a rolling boil), stir often, 4 to 5 min until slightly thicker.
Turn heat to low. Add parmesan a handful at a time, stirring until each handful melts. Season with pepper and a little salt (parm is salty, taste first).
Add the drained tortellini and stir to coat. Too thick? Add pasta water or milk a splash at a time.
source: Joe's Meal Pack, Oct 20 to Nov 4, 2026 (built by Thrifty, now kept by Meal Plan), R9
notes:
20 min. Sauce grainy? Heat was too high when the cheese went in. Keep it low and stir in a splash of cream or milk.
Storage: fridge 3 days; freezing not recommended (sauce separates). Reheat in microwave at 50% power, 1 min at a time, stirring, with a splash of milk. Or skillet over low with milk.
